notes.title: Story Update
notes.content:
Anomaly Escape is a small part of a huge universe. 
You can now find and unlock datapads with story clues.
The story texts are only clues and will only be explained further in future story games.
Datapads spawn randomly in the world and do not count as anomalies. They appear in single player and multiplayer.


[b]Added[/b]
[list]
[*] 10 Story Datapads
[*] 10 Steam achievements
[/list]


[b]Bugfix[/b]
[list]
[*] Report Button Text  placement fixed in singleplayer
[*] achievements were not triggered
[/list]

notes.title: Anomaly Escape - Full Release Patch Notes
notes.content:
We are excited to announce the full release of Anomaly Escape! Here are the latest updates and improvements:

[b]Multiplayer[/b]

Added CO-OP Mode: Now play together with other players over a Join Code on a new Map.


[b]Singleplayer[/b]
-Adjusted Lighting: Lighting has been revamped to create a more immersive and appealing game environment.
-Optimized Sounds: Annoying sounds have been reduced to ensure a more pleasant gaming experience.

Thank you for your support and we look forward to your feedback!
